messages:
Anna (CS): heads-up — GalacticGov wants to onboard a 13B legal-domain model into Private with DFARS/HSM requirements. They need SLA 99.9, <200ms p50 on short queries, and commit to 1 GPU reserved pool. Also asking for safety evals and a contract addendum. Who can take point?
Devon (SE): we can support Private + HSM. Need the model artifact (pt/onnx/ggml), model size, max seq. Do they require air-gapped on-prem or VPC with HSM?
Marco (ML Eng): performance-wise 13B can hit p50 <200ms on A100 if quantized + optimized kernels, but depends on seq len + batching. We should plan int8 or 4-bit. What's their token distribution?
Priya (Safety): what's the sensitive data surface? DFARS implies CUI — we need prompt redaction plan + targeted extraction test. Recommend running safety-check v3 plus 1k adversarial prompts.
Anna (CS): customer sent a sample config:
```json
{
  "model": "galactic-13b-legal",
  "format": "pt",
  "hsm_required": true,
  "dfars_control": true,
  "max_seq": 1024,
  "sla": {"p50_ms": 200},
  "reserved_gpus": 1
}
```
They also asked about audit logs retention 7 years and key rotation policy.
Devon (SE): sounds doable. We'll need security review + contract addendum for DFARS + HSM. Ops: can we provision a Private cluster with HSM? @onboard-bot create intake ticket.
onboard-bot: Created ticket CS-4321: galacticgov-private-hsm-intake. Assigned to Devon (SE). ETA: initial assessment 2 business days.
Anna (CS): noted. Customer is on an enterprise renewal cycle next quarter — this is a high-touch play; risk of churn if we can't commit capacity. I flagged to Sales.
Leila (AM): thanks @Anna (CS). I'll schedule a commercial + security kickoff with them for next Tue. Also looping legal for DFARS addendum. :calendar: 
Marco (ML Eng): I'll start the perf evals once we have their artifact. Please ask them to upload a ~200 sample prompt set and representative token lengths. I'll run an initial micro-benchmark and post results.
Priya (Safety): I'll draft the eval plan and send the checklist. Need to know allowed redaction approaches and failure modes they accept.
Anna (CS): great, thanks. Action items: 1) Devon — security/ops assessment (CS-4321). 2) Marco — perf eval after artifact. 3) Priya — safety eval plan. 4) Leila — schedule customer kickoff. I'll update the intake ticket with notes.
